Per task rule, do NOT invent a price: A2000's 3.9B tokens on this id remain UNPRICED (engine.priceComponent returns usd:null, status:'UNPRICED').

Quoting that page: 'It doesn't restore regular usage or unlock our most capable models... [it] doesn't add API credits to your account' — so it is not a separately-priced model. developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-reserve returns 404 and it has no row on developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing. Left UNPRICED rather than assumed equal to gpt-5.6-luna's rate, since Reserve access is plan-metered, not sold at a published per-token USD rate. A2000's 30M tokens on this id remain UNPRICED.
